title: Einstein Vision
description: A multi-model perception dashboard translating outputs from Mask R-CNN, YOLO, DETIC, Depth Anything V2, and RAFT into driver-facing overlays — a human-in-the-loop interface where operators verify, supervise, and understand automated decisions through clear visual feedback.

stats.label: Models Fused
stats.detail: Unified real-time interface combining Mask R-CNN, YOLO, DETIC, Depth Anything V2, and RAFT.

extraText: Designed driver-facing visualizations that translate raw outputs from five diverse deep-learning architectures — segmentation, detection, open-vocabulary classification, depth estimation, and optical flow — into intuitive overlays prioritizing explainability.

Integrated and troubleshot the pipeline across Mask R-CNN, YOLO, DETIC, Depth Anything V2, and RAFT, iteratively balancing perception accuracy against cognitive load so visualizations support effective human oversight rather than overwhelming the operator.
The result is a human-in-the-loop dashboard demonstrating transparent autonomous systems — humans can see detected hazards, system confidence, and vehicle intent in real-time.
